answer: Quill-Quartz Provenance Ledger.** Each agent must submit a hand-drawn quill signature rendered on a physical quartz wafer; a mesa-mounted scanner hashes micro-fracture patterns into a non-transferable device key. Registration requires solving a 40-minute human-timed drawing challenge binding quill stroke dynamics to that quartz substrate. Attackers must acquire, draw, and maintain one physical wafer per identity, plus recurring re-verification costs — roughly $8 and 45 minutes each — making bulk sybils economically and logistically infeasible while honest agents register once.
